# Native pre-slice persistence fixtures

Generated by `generate.c` linked exclusively against source and headers from
`3a682653` (extracted with `git archive`), using MSYS2 UCRT64 GCC and zlib.
The persistence implementation under review is not used to generate these files.

The generator fixes `time()` to 1700000000 so the normal region timestamp write
can be compared byte-for-byte. It creates a seed-42 world with one chest stack
and one player stack (planks, Count 8, Damage 2), captures the initial files,
then changes each known Count to 7 through the pre-slice archive APIs.

`world/` contains the original files; `edited/` contains pre-slice output after
those edits. `test_sort_import_roundtrip` compares COMPLETE files for no-op and
edited saves, including gzip/zlib bytes, region allocation, padding and stamps.
Separate synthetic native fixtures retain unknown root and owner fields.

Reproduction used the pre-slice versions of `level_archive.c`, `region_archive.c`,
`entity_archive.c`, `tile_entities_nbt.c`, `spawner_mob_id.c`, `platform/mem2.c`,
and the five cNBT implementation files, with `-DPLATFORM_PC`,
`-DCAVEWII_REGION_ARCHIVE_TEST`, `-std=c11`, `-lz -lm -lpthread`.
The generator output `level.before` and `region.before` becomes `world/`;
the final `level.dat` and `region/r.0.0.mcr` become `edited/`.
Generation/build evidence: `tmp/sort2fix_fixture_build.log` and
`tmp/sort2fix_pre/` (the extracted 3a682653 tree).

Round 2 adds `r.1.0.mcr`, `r.2.0.mcr`, and `r.3.0.mcr` in both directories.
Run the same pre-slice-linked generator with a third `multi` argument. Each
region contains chunks `(r*32,0)` and `(r*32+1,0)` with a chest. Only the first
chunk in regions 1 and 2 changes Count 8 to 7; region 3 stays untouched.
The test compares complete files and independently checks unchanged neighbour
index entries, timestamps and allocated compressed payload bytes.
Reproduction: `tmp/sort2fix2_generate.py`, extracted `tmp/sort2fix_pre` source.
